summary: Continued the interrupted data module. Inspection showed src/data/** and supabase/** were substantially complete and committed (a3d6639 / 0712125): Dexie repositories, sync engine, merge, PIN, dashboards, dev helper, auth/account, schools, and the 0001_init.sql migration with its RLS suite. The only failure was test isolation: 3 hook tests failed because the local .env.local (Supabase keys, gitignored) leaked into tests. Fixed by making the test helper resetAll() default to a local-only client (null) instead of undefined. No product code changed. Verified the Postgres RLS suite on a real local Postgres 16 (pgserver). Gallery screenshot could not be captured on this machine: tools/shot.mjs hardcodes a Linux Chromium path (/opt/pw-browsers/...) that does not exist on macOS.
